candidateDirections.label: Clinical neuroscience and neurological health
candidateDirections.finding: Genuine direction. Current physiology, pharmacology, molecular disease and cognition supply substantive contributions. They do not establish a dedicated clinical neuroscience pathway or resolve the external advanced clinical weight.

candidateDirections.label: Neurotechnology and rehabilitation
candidateDirections.finding: Genuine direction. Signals, mathematics, image processing and robotics are technical contributions; their descriptions do not establish brain stimulation, neural prosthetics or sustained brain-instrumentation training.

candidateDirections.label: Computational neuroscience
candidateDirections.finding: Genuine direction. Python, statistics, signals, numerical methods and learning algorithms can support neuroscience inquiry. Generic AI models must not be represented as taught biological-circuit models.

academicJudgment.claimTested: A meaningful complete UCR bachelor response to Human Neuroscience, or an explicitly limited comparison to its confirmed first-year neural/technical academic core.
academicJudgment.strongestPositiveArgument: The first year contains real cognitive, biological and technical neuroscience, rather than only generic skills. UCR has sustained neural/cognitive courses and actual quantitative teaching. The retained 24-course trial is a credible challenge to a negative conclusion. An academic-core branch has no numerical credit cutoff.
academicJudgment.decision: Retain external-programme-unresolved. The confirmed neural/technical subjects establish foundational correspondence, but do not identify a stable advanced academic core against which the complete UCR bachelor response can be judged. Excluding all provisional advanced formation would leave a preparatory comparison while the defining integration of cognition, clinical inquiry and neurotechnology remains outside the claim. This case-specific failure of substantive scope, rather than an automatic first-year/EC rule, prevents qualification.

adverseResolutions.credibleResolution: A substantial neurotechnology/instrumentation and clinical-intervention pathway develops the stated graduate outcomes.
adverseResolutions.effect: The trial would need different specialist preparation; generic signals, robotics and pharmacology cannot be certified as the defining practical training.

adverseResolutions.credibleResolution: Greater weight falls on cognitive experiments, neural data modelling and computational analysis, with specialist technical study more restricted.
adverseResolutions.effect: The same trial becomes a more plausible substantial response. Thus a robust programme-level no-match cannot be established.

adverseResolutions.effect: Foundational subject overlap survives, but it does not establish a meaningful bachelor-level comparison to the excluded advanced formation. Merely shortening the claim would conceal the unresolved target-level judgment.

academicJudgment.negativeProof: No robust no-match. Actual UCR neuroscience, neurobiology, cognitive experiments and quantitative methods are substantial; a favourable final cognitive/computational allocation could support a qualified response. Missing instruments or an exact degree title alone cannot prove no-match.

courseReview.verification: Opened the current repository workbook and compared every saved trial-course name, description2, profile, topics and methods value to its current row; all 24 matched. Read substantive contributions and direct/complementary limits, using description2 where no outline evidence exists.
courseReview.genuineStrengths: Brain/behaviour and neurobiology introduce neural structures, signalling and research. Perception/action, higher cognitive functions and psycholinguistics sustain cognition, including experimental work. Physiology, pharmacology and molecular pathology support biological/clinical questions. Programming, calculus, linear algebra, probability, experimental statistics, signals, numerical analysis, learning and image processing provide actual methods. Philosophy of mind and AI ethics are bounded conceptual contributions; meta-analysis supplies evidence synthesis.
courseReview.gaps: Signals does not promise EEG collection or stimulation; image processing does not establish neuroimaging instrumentation; general deep learning does not establish biological neural-circuit modelling; pharmacology and pathology do not establish clinical neurorehabilitation. No hypothetical independent project fills these gaps.
courseReview.trialStatus: Retained unapproved research challenge; freshly passes all fixed-cohort hard feasibility constraints. Its validity does not confer acceptance.
courseReview.progression: Biological/psychological gateways and Python precede dependent biomedical and computational work; calculus precedes signals/numerical methods. Early Psycholinguistics is allowed by actual formal rules and is the planned offering used by the trial. No advisory progression signal was turned into a new prerequisite.
